_note: EXAMPLE VALUES: the entries below are real rates for the current frontier models, verified against the official pricing pages on the 'checked' dates — they are a starting point, not a source of truth. Model prices change, so they are never hardcoded in the harness: copy this file, keep one entry per model you run as "<provider>/<model>", fill inputPerMTok and outputPerMTok in USD per million tokens, put the page you took them from in "source", and set "checked" to the date you verified them. Reasoning/thinking tokens bill as output tokens on every provider below, and they are inside the provider's reported output total, so outputPerMTok covers them — no separate reasoning rate. A run for a model without a matching entry reports costUsd: null rather than guessing.

anthropic/claude-fable-5-1.source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing and https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models/overview (flagship: demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work)

anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview — 'From' pricing for prompts up to 100,000 tokens ($0.50 input / $2.50 output per MTok above that)

openai/gpt-6-astra.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and https://openai.com/api/pricing (frontier reasoning model; rate shown is the standard tier for inputs up to 272K tokens — 20/75 above that; reasoning tokens are inside usage.output_tokens)

openai-chat/gemini-4-argon.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (flagship reasoning model; intro rate through 2026-11-30, rising to 4/20 on 2026-12-01; output price explicitly includes thinking tokens; reached through the openai-chat provider, so the key is openai-chat/<model>)
